description: This file defines the Font class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing functionality related to font management such as font constants, calculating column widths based on font metrics, font file path management, and font characteristic mappings.

classes.name: Font
classes.description: A class providing font management, measurement, and font file path utilities within PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: setExtraFontArray
methods.description: Sets the auxiliary font array used for font file resolution.

methods.name: getExtraFontArray
methods.description: Retrieves the auxiliary font array used for font file resolution.

methods.name: setAutoSizeMethod
methods.description: Sets the method used for auto-sizing columns: 'approx' or 'exact'.

methods.name: getAutoSizeMethod
methods.description: Returns the current auto-size measurement method.

methods.name: setTrueTypeFontPath
methods.description: Sets the directory path where TrueType font (.ttf) files are stored.

methods.name: getTrueTypeFontPath
methods.description: Returns the configured directory path for TrueType font files.

methods.name: calculateColumnWidth
methods.description: Calculates an approximate column width in Excel units based on font metrics and cell text.

methods.name: getTextWidthPixelsExact
methods.description: Calculates the exact pixel width of a given text string rendered with a specific font.

methods.name: getTextWidthPixelsApprox
methods.description: Estimates pixel width for text in a font at a certain rotation angle.

methods.name: fontSizeToPixels
methods.description: Converts a font size from points to approximate pixel size.

methods.name: inchSizeToPixels
methods.description: Converts inch-based font size to pixels.

methods.name: centimeterSizeToPixels
methods.description: Converts centimeter-based font size to pixels.

methods.name: getTrueTypeFontFileFromFont
methods.description: Resolves the TrueType font file path for a given font object.

methods.name: getCharsetFromFontName
methods.description: Returns the charset code associated with a font name.

methods.name: getDefaultColumnWidthByFont
methods.description: Returns the default column width for a given font, either in pixels or Excel units.

methods.name: getDefaultRowHeightByFont
methods.description: Returns the default row height for a given font.
